name: Curify Design Agent Unified Rubric v0.1

anchors.1: Core result is wrong, unusable, or violates a critical requirement.
anchors.2: Material requirements are missing or execution is substantially flawed.
anchors.3: Usable, but one or more important requirements are weak or unverified.
anchors.4: Correct and complete with only minor finish or evidence weakness.
anchors.5: All important requirements are observably met with no material defect.

quality_dimensions.label: Brief adherence
quality_dimensions.definition: Follows the requested operation, outputs, constraints, and exclusions.

quality_dimensions.label: Visual quality
quality_dimensions.definition: Visible craft, hierarchy, composition, legibility, realism or illustration finish, and absence of defects.

quality_dimensions.label: Creative diversity
quality_dimensions.definition: Required alternatives are meaningfully distinct concepts rather than superficial variants.

quality_dimensions.label: Brand consistency
quality_dimensions.definition: Preserves locked identity and correctly applies the declared brand or reference system.

quality_dimensions.label: Refinement ability
quality_dimensions.definition: Applies the requested delta while preserving protected content and recoverable approved state.

quality_dimensions.label: Cross-asset consistency
quality_dimensions.definition: Maintains a coherent system across assets while respecting their format-specific roles.

quality_dimensions.label: Production readiness
quality_dimensions.definition: Required formats, dimensions, file structure, preflight, and handoff evidence are valid for the claimed use.

quality_dimensions.label: Efficiency
quality_dimensions.definition: Completes within intended turns and declared budgets without avoidable retries or user loops.

agent_hard_gates.pass_condition: Required turns finish and the final response or artifact set exists.
The correct operation is selected, or the agent explicitly abstains when no supported capability exists.

agent_hard_gates.applies_when: one or more inputs or references are required
agent_hard_gates.pass_condition: All required inputs are consumed and only allowed reference channels are transferred.
Every case-specific invariant, exact-copy or count rule, privacy rule, and forbidden action passes.
Required count, type, format, and structured evidence files are present and readable.

agent_hard_gates.applies_when: L4, feedback, revision, selection, or recovery case
agent_hard_gates.pass_condition: Human selection precedes convergence and later turns preserve locked state and rollback scope.

agent_hard_gates.applies_when: print, vector, export, factory, or package claim
agent_hard_gates.pass_condition: Claimed file properties pass independent file and preflight inspection.

scoring_rules.applicability: Declare applicable dimensions and gates before candidate execution.
scoring_rules.quality_score: sum(weight * score / 5 for applicable dimensions) / sum(applicable weights)
scoring_rules.gated_score: quality_score when every applicable agent hard gate is MET; otherwise 0
scoring_rules.benchmark_pass: evaluator-valid AND every applicable agent hard gate is MET AND quality_score >= 0.70
scoring_rules.evaluator_missing_instrumentation: Report lower and upper bounds for missing weight; mark benchmark pass unavailable.
scoring_rules.not_applicable: Allowed only when declared before execution; renormalize across the remaining applicable weights.
scoring_rules.rubric_coverage: observed applicable weight / required applicable weight

legacy_crosswalk.rule: Partial evidence only; it cannot prove final-output adherence by itself.
Use only on edit or revision tasks and retain the original evidence.
Use only when brand or reference identity is an applicable requirement.
Treat as components; no single component automatically becomes the whole production score.
Report through the approval/state gate and workflow diagnostic panel.
No global automatic mapping; bind against the predeclared task success contract.

dataset_mapping.counting_rule: Lineage source for v0.3 core; never add independently to a v0.3 suite total.
Observed winner is a human choice signal, not objective visual-quality gold.
Count 32 core conditions and 11 external conditions once; report the two partitions separately.
